name: Agar Panna Cotta
steps: Mix agar powder with the cold milk in a saucepan, whisking until evenly dispersed. Use powder rather than flakes; check the packet setting guidance as brands differ.
Bring the milk mixture to a full simmer while stirring, then simmer for 2 minutes to dissolve the agar completely.
Add cream and sugar, stir until dissolved and bring back just to a gentle simmer for 1 minute.
Take off the heat, add vanilla and pour promptly into four ramekins; agar begins setting as it cools.
Cool, cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. Wash and hull strawberries and mash half into a simple unsweetened sauce.
Serve in the ramekins or loosen carefully and unmould. Spoon strawberries and sauce over each portion.
tips: Setting and chilling take at least 3 hours. This version uses plant-derived agar.
passiveTime: Allow additional soaking, resting, chilling or fermentation as specified in the steps.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
